metadata.title: Beacon Reveal
metadata.author: generated from an FTL event wiki
metadata.description:
Prints the name of every event on the sector map, above its beacon, whether or not the beacon has been explored. A map spoiler, on purpose.
Requires FTL Hyperspace. Draws only - no event, choice, reward, ship or probability is changed, and nothing is written to the save.
386 events are named, from the same card titles the Event Labels mod uses. An event with no card shows its raw id rather than an invented name.
